notes.title: The MAX level required for upgrading the magic barrier has been changed to 110
notes.content:
1. The maximum level required for upgrading the magic barrier has been changed to level 110
2. Fix bug where attributes of level 100 and level 110 suits cannot be displayed correctly

notes.title: The drop of strengthening stones and gems
notes.content: After the 50th floor, the floor has increased the drop of strengthening stones and gems

notes.title: Weakens floor 47 monsters
notes.content:
1. Weakens floor 47 monsters
2. Fix bugs in tasks such as "Kill Tot God" that prevent rewards from being claimed

notes.title: Reduced the health and attack power of Ice Bone Dragon.
notes.content:
1. Reduced the health and attack power of Ice Bone Dragon.
2. Change the fragments required for monsters such as the Centaur Warrior and the Sky Cavalry to their own fragments, instead of the fragments of the Holy King.

notes.title: Monster attribute weakening
notes.content: Greatly weakened monsters after floor 37.

notes.title: Bug fixing
notes.content:
1. Fixed attribute errors in sapphire.
2. Fix the drop items error of floor 50.
3. The mining time has been changed to a maximum of 24 hours.

notes.title: Bug fixed
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug where offline equipment was sometimes not provided.
2. Fixed a bug in the dungeon where selling equipment did not refresh the amount of coins and diamonds in a timely manner.
3.The drop of a 90 level shield has been adjusted from floor 50 to floor 53.
4. Change the boss after the Holy King to a group attack.

notes.title: Add 110 level horse
notes.content: Add 110 level horse

notes.title: Numerical adjustment
notes.content:
1. The dungeon has added drops of sapphires, amethysts, and dark crystals.
2. Adjusted the monsters in level 43.
3. Adjusted the level limit for upgrading some skills to level 8 to level 110.

notes.title: Game experience improvement
notes.content:
1. Cancel the remake that requires strengthening at least 4 times for power.
2. Added Phantom Fragments to the 5th level boss.
3. Added  power display in the equipment TIPS.

notes.title: Game experience optimization
notes.content:
1. BOSS tower refresh times can now be purchased in bulk.
2. Fixed special effects errors in group therapy.
3. Three tasks in the task have become daily tasks.

notes.title: Purchase boss tower reset times now
notes.content:
1. You can use diamonds to purchase boss tower reset times now.
2. Added the upper limit of randomly generated attributes for equipment during training.
3. Added drop of shattered amethyst on levels 22, 23, and 24.
4.During the battle, backpacks were also classified.
5. Fix other bugs.

notes.title: Fix bugs and improve gaming experience
notes.content:
1. Cancel the store, expand the backpack (a total of 400 squares), and add new categories to the backpack.
2. Fixed the issue of the Warhorse upgrade button disappearing.
3. When synthesizing books, you can choose the specified book page.
4. Fixed bug for priest level 5 and above skill upgrades.
5. Fixed bug in backpack where equipment enhancement does not refresh.
6.After the BOSS tower battle fails, it can automatically refresh.
7. Slightly weakened monsters on level 47.

notes.title: Game experience optimization
notes.content:
1. Continue to increase the number of drops of BOSS tower materials.
2. The Store has added one page of space.
3. Upgrade items and Summon monster, synthesizing books and suit, the materials in the bag and store can be used directly at the same time.
4.The items in the store can be directly deleted.
5. Revised the description of some drugs
6.The refresh rate of the BOSS tower is fixed at 10 times.

notes.title: Fixed some bugs
notes.content:
1. Fix the skill bug that increases defense for priests.
2. Fix the issue of unreasonable drop rate setting in the 10th layer.
3. When enhancing and inlaying equipment on the body, character attributes can be refreshed.
4. Reduced upgrade experience points after level 50.
5. Fixed some text description errors.
6. A small bug in the boss tower.

notes.title: Improve the game's combat rhythm
notes.content:
1. Accelerate the battle rhythm of heroes and make the game more enjoyable.
2. Increased the drop rate of ordinary dungeon items, doubling it.
3. Increased the item drop rate of the boss tower, allowing low-level bosses to drop up to 3 items at a time.

notes.title: Significantly weakened upgrade experience
notes.content:
1. Upgrade experience reduced to half of the previous level.
2. Added renaming function.
3. The BOSS tower has been refreshed 50 times a day.
4. The level limit has been increased to level 110.
5. Some displayed errors have been corrected.
6.Wearing equipment on the body can also power and inlay gemstones.

notes.title: Modified the critical hit rate formula
notes.content: Modified the critical hit rate formula, as the true value of the critical hit rate was lower than the displayed value of the attribute. Simultaneously reducing the maximum critical hit rate of dropped items.

notes.title: Added Traditional Chinese
notes.content: Added traditional Chinese and bulk selling。

notes.title: The shop can now make bulk purchases.
notes.content:
The prices of all items have been modified, and there are no more items with a selling price of 0. Clearing can also earn coins or diamonds, and the shop can now make bulk purchases.
The items in the backpack can also be sold in bulk. The sorting of backpack items has also been optimized. Now when the mouse hovers over an item, there is a Tip to quickly view its properties.
